likely_reference_errors.detail: Medical record discrepancy regarding the exact date of the gym weightlifting injury causing neck pain, Dr. Alistair Finch, MD, Back & Spine Restoration Center.
likely_reference_errors.explanation: There is a genuine date ambiguity (intake 'last week' from 09/10 vs. eval note '6 days ago' from 09/12, i.e. ~09/03 vs ~09/06), but the source itself never frames this as a 'discrepancy' nor attributes p2 to Dr. Finch, since p2 is a patient-completed form.

likely_reference_errors.detail: Initial physical therapy evaluation following post-surgical ORIF of left humerus and radius with significant functional limitations, Robert Stewart, PT, DPT, Lang-Weimann Medical Center.
likely_reference_errors.explanation: p1 is the initial evaluation with pain 8/10, ROM/strength deficits, and antalgic gait/modified independence, which supports 'significant functional limitations,' but the note does not use that exact phrase, so wording is a reasonable but non-verbatim characterization.

likely_reference_errors.detail: Physical therapy session focused on upper extremity stabilization and myofascial cervical release with good tolerance, Amanda Gregory, PT, OCS, Emory Sports Medicine Complex.
likely_reference_errors.explanation: p21 (Visit 20, 02/23/2024) session focus is 'Upper extremity stabilization. Myofascial cervical release' and tolerance is listed as 'Good', but the assessment also notes 'Cervical symptoms provoked this session; monitored and modified,' which the event's characterization as simply 'good tolerance' obscures/contradicts.

likely_reference_errors.detail: Nerve block tray administered for anesthesia during surgical procedure, Dr. Elizabeth Foster, MD, Littel Inc Emergency Hospital.
likely_reference_errors.explanation: P2 lists 'NERVE BLOCK TRAY' charge on 09/04/2023 under REV 0370 but does not attribute this to Dr. Elizabeth Foster or specify it was for anesthesia during a specific surgical procedure; Dr. Foster is only named as attending on p1, not tied to this specific line item.

likely_reference_errors.detail: Initial physical therapy evaluation for left arm fractures and cervicalgia, Robert Stewart, PT, DPT, Lang-Weimann Medical Center - Physical Therapy.
likely_reference_errors.explanation: P8 shows CPT 97161 (PT evaluation) on 09/15/2023 by Robert Stewart, PT, DPT with diagnosis codes S42.302A and M54.2, supporting an initial PT evaluation for arm fracture and cervicalgia, but does not specify 'left arm' laterality.

conflicts_found_in_source.detail: Surgical procedures performed on left arm fractures sustained in motor vehicle accident, Dr. Elizabeth Foster, MD, Littel Inc Emergency Hospital.
conflicts_found_in_source.explanation: The UB-04 (p1) diagnosis codes are S42.302A (right humerus fracture, per convention 'right arm'), S52.302A (forearm fracture), and M54.2 (cervicalgia), with procedure codes OPS00ZZ/0PSG0ZZ, none of which specify 'left arm' -- in fact other CMS-1500 forms (p5, p10) use laterality code 'LT' for left-side orthopedic CPT codes, suggesting the fracture was on the left, but the UB-04 itself does not state 'left arm' and the diagnosis codes visible here do not confirm laterality.

questionable_dates.detail: Sustained severe neck pain and stiffness during weightlifting accident at gym, described as occurring during heavy squat set, Dr. Alistair Finch, MD, Back & Spine Restoration Center.
questionable_dates.explanation: Intake form dated 09/10/2022 states injury occurred 'last week' during a heavy weightlifting accident, and the eval note (p3) says pain began 6 days before 09/12/2022 (~09/06), so 09/03 is not clearly supported and this event is misattributed to Dr. Finch when p2 is a patient-completed questionnaire with no provider signature.

incorrect_source_attribution.detail: Immediate consultation with orthopedic surgery for emergency open reduction and internal fixation, Dr. Elizabeth Foster, MD, Littel Inc Emergency Hospital.
incorrect_source_attribution.explanation: The p5 note states 'Consult Orthopedic Surgery (Dr. Myrtle Turner) immediately for emergency open reduction and internal fixation (ORIF)' authored/signed by Dr. Elizabeth Foster, so the consulted surgeon is Dr. Turner, not Dr. Foster as the event implies.

incorrect_source_attribution.detail: X-ray showing well-healed left humerus and distal radius fractures with stable internal hardware and excellent bony bridging, Dr. Myrtle Turner, MD, FACS, Turner Orthopedic & Reconstruction Specialist Group.
incorrect_source_attribution.explanation: The imaging findings ('Well-healed left humerus and left distal radius fractures with stable internal hardware,' 'excellent bony bridging callus') are accurately quoted from p7, but the report is signed/interpreted by Dr. Myrtle Turner as radiologist per p7/p8, so attribution is technically correct though it's a diagnostic imaging report rather than a follow-up visit note, and this is distinct from the same-date office follow-up note (p4) which discusses different findings (persistent ROM restriction, ordering MRI) not mentioned in this imaging-only event.

ALISTAIR FINCH, MD' only as referring provider, not explicitly confirmed as treating clinician for cervicalgia; date and provider match but detail of 'prior treatment for cervicalgia' is reasonably supported.
